NaturastodisPath.Title: Naturastodis
NaturastodisPath.Description: Naturastodis is a path only available to pawns with the natural meditation focus type. They are capable of harnessing the power of nature to hinder their enemies or to enhance your pawns or animals.
NaturastodisPath.Tooltip: Naturastodis psycasters are mostly Foxians, or non-Foxians living among them. They are capable of exploiting nature itself for their own goals. They are generally seen as support psycasters, as they can help their allies by healing them, strengthening tamed animals, or granting them blessings from sacrificial rituals. Additionally, they can also weaken their enemies with various offensive psycasts, such as launching wood lances or placing artificial wooden mines.

WoodLance.Title: wood lance
WoodLance.Description: Condenses and converts psychic entropy into artificial wood and sends a wood lance at the targeted enemy.

NatureFinest.Title: nature's finest
NatureFinest.Description: Psychically enhance the tamed animals around the psycaster. The affected animals will become more agile and better at melee, and all their bleeding wounds will almost instantly seal themselves for the duration of the effect.

ThornExplosion.Title: thorn explosion
ThornExplosion.Description: Focuses and directs psychic entropy into the targeted soil to manipulate the wood matter within, triggering an explosion of needles. Any enemies hit by the explosion will be weakened by the psychic toxins infused into those needles.

BarSkin.Title: bark skin
BarSkin.Description: Psychically enhance the target's flesh, turning it into living wood. The effect is temporary, and its duration scales with the psychic sensitivity of the psycaster. The living bark makes the chosen target more resistant to incoming hits and damage, at the cost of being slower and very vulnerable to fire.

NatureHealing.Title: nature's healing
NatureHealing.Description: Psychically heals the pawns around the psycaster. The user will instantly soothe random wounds of all allies and animals within their range. The strength of this psycast scales with the user's psychic sensitivity.

SporeInfection.Title: spore infection
SporeInfection.Description: Spread psychic spore-like particles that infect the nearby pawns within the area of effect. They will hinder anyone's ability to fight and think, and they will multiply within the subject's body with each hit from an offensive psycast of this path. The spores themselves are not lethal. The worst they can do is knock someone unconscious. However, accidentally hitting an innocent bystander or an ally from another faction will be considered a hostile action and will worsen diplomatic relations.

WoodTrap.Title: wood trap
WoodTrap.Description: Permeate a soil surface with psychic entropy and morph the plant matter around it into an artificial wooden landmine filled with explosive gas and thick wooden needles that will spew out everywhere upon detonation. Although the mine doesn't do as much damage as a normal IED trap, enemies that are hit by the needles will be physically weaker and less effective in close combat for a while.

NatureGuardian.Title: nature's guardians
NatureGuardian.Description: Psychically transmute a tree into a living being. The guardian treant is immediately loyal to the person who summoned it and will protect that person until death or expiration. The guardian is slow and bulky, but it is capable of withstanding a lot of damage and delivering heavy blows. It does not need to sleep or eat, but it is not permanent and will disappear if it does not die in combat first. Its duration depends on the psycaster's psychic sensitivity. When it dies, it will vanish into thin air.

NaturaBloom.Title: natura bloom
NaturaBloom.Description: Condense the soil with psychic entropy and germinate a sapling of a Natura tree. The sapling can only be psychically rooted on terrain suitable for plants.

NatureSacrifice.Title: nature's sacrifice
NatureSacrifice.Description: Transform a downed pawn into a sacrificial tree, allowing you to offer it as a sacrifice and perform a sacrificial ritual for the gods in exchange for a temporary bonus. The bonus received depends on the psychic sensitivity of the pawn leading the ritual. If the ritual fails, the ritualist will suffer a debuff.

FateManipulation.Title: fate manipulation
FateManipulation.Description: Psychically focus to bend the odds and forcefully trigger an incident. The incident will be random. There is also a rare chance that nothing happens. An excellent outcome is guaranteed after a specific number of uses.

BloodRainDeel.Title: Blood Rain deel
BloodRainDeel.Description: A traditional Blood Rain outfit reinforced with steel plates. It is used to convey the wearer's importance within the organization. Although the outfit is not as protective as conventional armor, it is light enough that the wearer can move without hindrance, and it is embedded with Blood Rain runes to physically enhance the wearer. It is rumored that the empress gave these outfits to those she trusts the most to carry out her more deranged orders.

BloodRainSkullArmor.Title: Blood Rain skull armor
BloodRainSkullArmor.Description: An armor made from metal and bones that is typically worn by veteran and even elite members of the Blood Rain. The armor features skulls as shoulder pads and is carved with basic runes that enhance the physical prowess of the wearer. The human skulls generally come from unfortunate victims who met their demise in a Blood Rain raid, or from deceased relatives of Blood Rain members.

BloodRainSkullHelmet.Title: Blood Rain skull helmet
BloodRainSkullHelmet.Description: A helmet made from a human skull and reinforced with metal. It is commonly worn by veteran and elite members of the Blood Rain.

FOPSVest.Title: F.O.P.S. bulletproof vest
FOPSVest.Description: A complete bulletproof vest used by F.O.P.S. operators. The Federal Operations & Protection Service is a special unit comprising the best soldiers of the League. They are given the most difficult tasks, which the League's army can't accomplish without significant sacrifices. Their secondary mission is to protect important assets of the League, whether people or items. The vest is lightweight and includes ammunition pockets, which allow the wearer to shoot faster and with greater precision while granting them improved mobility.

FOPSBeret.Title: F.O.P.S. beret
FOPSBeret.Description: A beret belonging to the F.O.P.S. special services. While it does not offer much protection compared to a helmet, it allows the wearer to be lighter and more confident when handling their ranged weapon.

OracleRobe.Title: Foxian oracle robe
OracleRobe.Description: A prestigious ceremonial robe with patterns made of hyperweave and Eltex that is awarded only to the most accomplished Foxian psycasters. Not only is this robe a symbol of power for any acolyte within the church, but it also strengthens the wearer's psychic ability. To become an oracle, one must dedicate their entire life, or a good part of it, to communing with their chosen gods in the hope of receiving their divine benediction. Once blessed, they must prove their worth by accomplishing various tasks related to their chosen god to finally be approved as an oracle.

FOPSRiffle.Title: F.O.P.S. service rifle
FOPSRiffle.Description: A suppressed assault rifle designed for covert operations, used by F.O.P.S. operators when stealth is an option. It fires two poisonous rounds per burst, has good range, and has an accuracy ideal for long-range targets.

HarpoonGun.Title: harpoon blaster
HarpoonGun.Description: A makeshift harpoon launcher used by the Blood Rain to deal with armored targets. It has medium range, with good accuracy against medium and long-range targets. At close range, its awkward design makes it difficult to aim. The harpoons hit hard and have high armor penetration. However, due to the clunky design of the weapon, reloading and aiming it takes quite a long time.

OracleStaff.Title: oracle staff
OracleStaff.Description: A wooden staff with a piece of Eltex fixed on its tip. The staff itself is not a dangerous weapon, but Foxian psycasters use it to enhance and support their psycasting abilities. This kind of staff is generally awarded to Foxian psycasters who have proven themselves by reaching the rank of Oracle within their local church. Reaching that rank is no easy feat, as one may need to dedicate their entire life to communing with their gods in the hope of receiving their approval. The staff can absorb the life essence of enemies it has killed in battle and turn that essence into psyfocus for the wielder.

NaturaTreeConnection.Title: natural connection
NaturaTreeConnection.Description: This devotee has received the blessing of a Natura tree for their devotion. The blessings permanently increase the psychic sensitivity of the chosen individual. The bonus grows as more blessings are earned.

RottenResilience.Title: rotten resilience
RottenResilience.Description: This creature exhibits unholy resistance because of its rotten body. When it is hit by an attack, there is a chance that the damage received will be reduced by a percentage.

SporeInfectionEffect.Title: spore infection
SporeInfectionEffect.Description: This person has been temporarily psychically infected by spore-like particles, hindering their physical and mental capabilities.

TreantSpecialBodyEffect.Title: psychic body
TreantSpecialBodyEffect.Description: This creature's body is not entirely physical but rather psychic, and this being will disappear after a certain amount of time. It cannot bleed and doesn't need to eat anything. If the creature dies, it will vanish instead of leaving a body.

BarSkinEffect.Title: bark skin
BarSkinEffect.Description: This person has received a psychic blessing that temporarily hardens the outer layer of their skin, making them more resistant to incoming damage at the cost of being slower and very vulnerable to fire.

NatureFinestEffect.Title: animal overclock
NatureFinestEffect.Description: This animal has been temporarily psychically altered by a psycaster. Its instincts, speed, and strength have been enhanced. Its bleeding wounds will also close instantly.

BlessingCunning.Title: blessing of the cunning
BlessingCunning.Description: This person has been blessed by one of the Foxian sacred beasts, representing the aspect of trickery and knowledge. For some ungodly reason, it decided to bless this person with dexterous hands and sharper eyesight to strengthen their shooting ability. For what purpose? We will never know, unless there was none to begin with.

BlessingFortitude.Title: blessing of fortitude
BlessingFortitude.Description: This person has been blessed by one of the Foxian sacred beasts, representing the aspect of Foxian will and the tenacity to live. This person will temporarily be able to work faster and for longer without needing sleep.

BlessingHarmony.Title: blessing of harmony
BlessingHarmony.Description: This person has been blessed by the sacred beast Vulpas, who granted them a fragment of its power for a limited time.

BlessingPower.Title: blessing of power
BlessingPower.Description: This person has been blessed by one of the Foxian sacred beasts, representing the aspect of duty and bravery. This person will receive divine strength to act upon the will of the beast, to physically protect their allies or to end as many threats as possible.

CursesDrain.Title: curse of drain
CursesDrain.Description: This person has been cursed by an entity seeking to drain their psychic sensitivity. For a limited time, this individual will have their psychic capacities reduced.

CurseRot.Title: curse of decay
CurseRot.Description: This person has been cursed by one of the Foxian sacred beasts, representing the aspect of decay and decadence. They will be temporarily sick until the disease goes away on its own. The disease can worsen the condition of the living subject and can even kill them outright if untreated.

CursesSubmission.Title: curse of compliance
CursesSubmission.Description: This person has been cursed by one of the Foxian sacred beasts, representing the aspect of subjugation and domination. They constantly fight the urge to give up their struggle for survival and submit to their enemies. While this effect is active, they will be less effective in combat and more susceptible to foreign ideologies.

CursesNightmare.Title: curse of nightmares
CursesNightmare.Description: This person has been cursed by one of the Foxian sacred beasts, representing the aspect of terror and inevitable dread. They will experience terrible nightmares, preventing them from sleeping and working efficiently for the duration of the curse.

FakeEars.Title: Foxian fake ears
FakeEars.Description: An installed pair of Foxian fake ears. They inflict continuous pain on the user and make them more prone to obey their masters.

PainNail.Title: pain nail
PainNail.Description: An installed pain nail. It inflicts pain on the user in exchange for strength and speed. The wearer will be in constant pain and more vulnerable to damage, and any extra pain will feel more intense. They will be unable to focus when learning new skills.

NaturaFlowerSprout.Label: Natura flower sprout
NaturaFlowerSprout.Description:
A Natura flower has sprouted nearby!

Harvest it to collect a Natura seed. This special seed can be used to plant a sublime Natura tree.

Any colonist with the natural meditation focus type can meditate near the tree and might receive its blessing by dedicating their meditation time to it. Being blessed by a Natura tree will permanently enhance the psychic sensitivity of the favored colonist.

Scenarios.Title: Blood Rain in Exile
Scenarios.Description: After a heated argument with your former local commander, you and your friends decided that you had had enough of her incompetence and planned to leave, Blood Rain style.\nAfter successfully stealing some supplies from your former comrades, you and your group finally settled somewhere far from your former base before your supplies ran out completely.
Scenarios.Summary: Three Foxian Blood Rain exiles attempt to create a new settlement after an argument with their former local boss.
Scenarios.MessageBox: After losing the soldiers sent by your ex-commander, you and your group have finally found a place to settle, just as your supplies were running thin.\nAfter the tiring journey, only freedom awaits you now.\nYour relationship with the Blood Rain has deteriorated because of your outrageous heist, but it can still be mended with some concessions on your part. However, in the eyes of the Foxian League, you and your friends are still considered dangerous outlaws.

Hulkarash.Description: A fox-like beast that resembles a massive mammoth and has seven tusks. Hulkarash are the offspring of one of the sacred beasts of subjugation and domination that sided with the Blood Rain when the first Foxian civilization collapsed. They are used as war beasts when besieging settlements, due to their sheer strength and their ability to spew liquid fire from their mouths. The Blood Rain considers them the ultimate weapon of mass destruction, and finding a non-hostile one in the wild is a rare sight.

TricksterCat.Description: A hybrid cat-fox creature commonly seen in Foxian settlements. They are essentially normal cats, except for their innate talent for reading the future and bending the odds. Their nickname comes from their love of mischief and their theorized association with the sacred beast of trickery and knowledge. Despite their mischievousness, they can show affection to their owners when they are not busy trying to curse your colony with mild inconveniences.

Vulpano.Description: A large fox-like herbivore similar to a muffalo. Vulpanos are quite docile, but when enraged they can be deadly. Tamed Vulpanos can be trained and used as pack animals.\nThe Foxian League relies heavily on these hardy beasts, using them almost exclusively as pack animals for trade caravans and long-distance transport. Encountering one outside of Foxian settlements is a rare sight. Although they bear some physical similarities to muffalos and even share some DNA with them, there is currently no scientific hypothesis to explain how this could have happened.

Vulyakko.Description: A fox-tiger hybrid that is half living and half rotting. Vulyakkos are the offspring of one of the sacred beasts of decay and decadence that sided with the Blood Rain when the first Foxian civilization collapsed. Blood Rain raiders use Vulyakkos as cannon fodder or hunting beasts. Due to their rotting condition, Vulyakkos can't reproduce naturally and can survive for days without eating. Nobody currently knows what happened to the sacred beasts that bore this hideous offspring.

GuardianTreant.Title: guardian treant
GuardianTreant.Description: A sacred guardian of nature, brought to life by the psychic entropy of a Naturastodis. This creature might be slow, but it can withstand heavy damage and deal some as well. Unfortunately for the Naturastodis, this creature is not permanent and will vanish at some point if it does not die in a fight first. During its duty, this creature will not sleep or eat anything.

NaturaTree.Title: Natura tree
NaturaTree.Description: An unknown tree found exclusively on this rimworld. It is typically seen inside settlements belonging to the Foxian League. Nevertheless, some outlanders claim to have seen these trees outside the sphere of influence of the Foxian League. Foxians and naturalist psycasters believe that they can receive blessings when meditating next to one. They only grow from seeds extracted from Natura flowers, or when planted by a psycaster with the coveted hidden knowledge.

SacrificialTree.Title: sacrificial tree
SacrificialTree.Description: An artificial, morbid tree with a humanoid silhouette visible on its bark. Its name comes from its association with the sacrificial ritual that Naturastodis psycasters perform in the hope of receiving blessings from their gods. Most people do not know why this tree has this specific humanoid form, because the Naturastodis psycasters keep this information secret. However, many non-psycaster Foxians firmly believe that a human body was used to make this tree.

FateManipulation.Title: fate manipulation
FateManipulation.Description: Command the animal to manipulate fate and forcefully trigger an incident that might be positive or negative.

FireSpew.Title: fire spew
FireSpew.Description: Command the animal to spit a stream of sticky, flammable bile from its mouth that ignites anything it touches.

WoodMine.Title: explosive wooden trap
WoodMine.Description: An artificial trap made by a Naturastodis psycaster. It is made of wood with a volatile gas inside. It detonates when someone steps on it or when a bullet hits it. Since it is made of wood, it blends easily into any terrain, making it nearly impossible to spot. Animals can sense it when calm. Since it is hidden in the surrounding terrain, it cannot be placed adjacent to other traps. When the trap explodes, it propels hundreds of toxic wooden needles into the surrounding area. Anyone struck by them will experience numbness depending on how much damage they have taken.

SacrificialTreeRitual.Title: sacrificial tree ritual
SacrificialTreeRitual.Description: One person will perform the ritual sacrifice with the chosen tree. Others might gather around the ritualist to strengthen the ritual. If everything goes well, the ritualist's chances of receiving a benediction will increase. Otherwise, they might receive a curse. The outcome of the ritual depends on the ritualist's psychic sensitivity and the number of participants.

KeyLocalization.FoxianModSettingsWarning: Changing any value might require a restart or reloading a save!
KeyLocalization.FoxianInformation: You can get more information about each setting by hovering your mouse over the labels.
KeyLocalization.PsychicManipulationSettingsDesc: This number means you gain a bonus skill point for every x% of psychic sensitivity beyond 100%. Each pawn has a base psychic sensitivity of 100% (unless they have traits or genes that change the default value).\nBy default, the threshold is 25%, so a pawn with 150% psychic sensitivity will gain 2 bonus social skill points.
KeyLocalization.PsychicManipulationSettingSkillsDropDown: The skill shown on the button will receive the bonus skill points from the gene.
KeyLocalization.AnimalConnectionSettingsDesc: This threshold represents how much psychic sensitivity a pawn needs to trigger the "Animal Connection" effect. By default, the value is set to 150%. Setting the value to 0% will disable the trigger.
KeyLocalization.GeneticPurityFoxianTrigger: Must a person be a Foxian to trigger the first behavior of the genetic purity gene?
KeyLocalization.GeneticPurityFoxianTriggerDesc: By default, only a Foxian or a person considered "Foxian enough" can give birth to an offspring with xenotype A or B. Otherwise, they will pass all their genes on to the offspring. If you disable this condition, anyone with this gene will be able to give birth to xenotype A or B, whether they are Foxian or not.
KeyLocalization.GeneticPuritySettingXenotypeADesc: The xenotype shown on the button will be used for offspring with xenotype A. By default, xenotype A is set to the Foxian xenotype.
KeyLocalization.GeneticPuritySettingXenotypeBDesc: The xenotype shown on the button will be used for offspring with xenotype B. By default, xenotype B is set to the Greater Foxian xenotype.
KeyLocalization.GeneticPurityXenotypeAChanceSlider: Chance for offspring to be xenotype A
KeyLocalization.GeneticPurityXenotypeAChanceSliderDesc: By default, the offspring has a 70% chance of being born as xenotype A. If the value is set to 0%, the offspring will always be born as xenotype B. If set to 100%, the offspring will always be born as xenotype A.
KeyLocalization.GeneticPurityXenotypeMaleChanceSlider: Chance for an offspring to be male (xenotype B)
KeyLocalization.GeneticPurityXenotypeMaleChanceSliderDes: By default, when the offspring is born with xenotype B, it has a 70% chance of being male. If this value is set to 0%, the offspring will always be female. If set to 100%, the offspring will always be male when born with xenotype B.
KeyLocalization.GeneticPurityXenotypeFemaleChanceSliderA: Chance for an offspring to be female (when the mother is not a Foxian)

By default, when the mother is not a Foxian, the offspring has an 80% chance of being female. If this value is set to 0%, the offspring will always be male. If set to 100%, the offspring will always be female.\nPlease note that this modifier does nothing if the "Must a person be a Foxian to trigger the first behavior of the genetic purity gene?" option has been disabled.
KeyLocalization.maxProgressTreeMultiplierSlider: Multiplier for the amount of meditation needed to trigger a blessing
KeyLocalization.maxProgressTreeMultiplierSliderDesc: Changes how long you need to meditate to trigger a blessing. Lower values shorten the time needed, while higher values lengthen it.
KeyLocalization.IsFoxianBi: Does the Lustful gene force the Bisexual trait?
KeyLocalization.IsFoxianBiDesc: The title is self-explanatory. Simply removes/adds the forced trait to the gene (a restart is required).
KeyLocalization.FoxianTailAgeInfo: Please be cautious when changing the values below.\nThe values must be in ascending order, as shown below.\nA restart is required.
KeyLocalization.FoxianOneTailAgeDesc: Set the age at which the pawn gets one tail (recommended: 0).
KeyLocalization.FoxianThreeTailAgeDesc: Set the age at which the pawn gets three tails (recommended: 3).
KeyLocalization.FoxianFiveTailAgeDesc: Set the age at which the pawn gets five tails.
KeyLocalization.FoxianSevenTailAgeDesc: Set the age at which the pawn gets seven tails.
KeyLocalization.FoxianNineTailAgeDesc: Set the age at which the pawn gets nine tails.
KeyLocalization.FoxianMedievalModeDesc: This option transforms the two Foxian factions into medieval factions centered around melee. This is not a patch for the Medieval Overhaul mod, since one is already included automatically. It is simply an option for players seeking a vanilla medieval run.\nA restart is required.
KeyLocalization.FoxianModWarningText:
This warning will only appear once.
If you just started a new save, you can disregard this warning.

The mod has recently received a big update. Many new features have been added, and older ones have been reworked.
As a result, some things from older save files might not work correctly anymore. The most likely culprits are the psychic channeling and protection genes.

However, this does not mean you need to start a new save. On the mod's Workshop page, you can find a link to a downloadable archive of the old version, so you can continue playing your current save without any issues. Alternatively, you can copy the same link to the clipboard with the button below.
Once on the GitHub page, click the "Code" button and then "Download ZIP". Finally, install the old version manually as a separate mod.
KeyLocalization.FoxianModWarningAccept: I've read the warning and am aware of the potential repercussions if I don't take the necessary precautions
KeyLocalization.NotProgressMultiplierLoc: No progress until the tree reaches full maturity
KeyLocalization.BlessingReceivedTitleLoc: {0_nameDef}'s prayers have finally been answered. {0_pronoun} received a blessing from the Natura tree itself!\nAs a result, {0_nameDef}'s psychic sensitivity has been permanently increased.
KeyLocalization.AbilityTargetMustTargetTree: Target must be a valid tree.
KeyLocalization.LetterTextSacrificialRitualSatisfyingCom: {0_labelShort} has successfully completed the sacrificial ritual and managed to satisfy the bloodlust of the gods.\n\n{0_pronoun} received a rare artifact from the gods.
KeyLocalization.LetterTextSacrificialRitualSuccessComple: {0_labelShort} has successfully completed the sacrificial ritual.\n\n{0_pronoun} received a blessing from the gods as a reward for {0_possessive} faithfulness.
KeyLocalization.LetterTextSacrificialRitualOffensiveComp: {0_labelShort} has fumbled the sacrificial ritual and offended the gods.\n\n{0_pronoun} received a curse from the gods for {0_possessive} mistake.
KeyLocalization.SacrificialRitualExplanationBase: The sacrificial tree ceremony is more powerful with more participants and with a highly psy-sensitive ritualist. The more people participate, the less time the ceremony takes, and the higher the chance of receiving a benediction instead of a curse.\n\nWith our current configuration, we will have {0} to receive a positive reward and {1} for an excellent outcome.
KeyLocalization.RitualTargetSacrificialTreeMustBeCapable: Must be a colonist with the natural meditation focus type
KeyLocalization.PawnCannotReceiveSacrificialBlessings: This pawn cannot receive any more blessings for the time being.
KeyLocalization.SacrificialRitualReceiveRareItem: {0_labelShort} has been favored with the following item: {1_label}
